movies.overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.
movies.title: Resident Evil

movies.overview: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.
movies.title: Apocalypse Z: New World

movies.overview: Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood...where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.
movies.title: A Story of Derry

movies.overview: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.
movies.tagline: There is no third time. Everything ends here.
movies.title: Godzilla Minus Zero

movies.overview: A medical mission deep in the Amazon becomes a desperate fight for survival when a colossal ancient predator awakens, turning the jungle into a deadly battleground where nature decides who lives and dies.
movies.tagline: Witness terror on a gigantic scale.
movies.title: Beware Boiúna

movies.overview: Young Bela forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home that looks uncannily like her own mother, drawing her into a terrifying and increasingly dark world.
movies.title: Other Mommy

movies.overview: An elite military unit on a mission in the South American jungle encounters a deadly supernatural force revealing an ancient presence that continues to claim anyone who dares enter its domain.
movies.title: The Awakening

movies.overview: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.
movies.title: Buddy

movies.overview: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.
movies.tagline: He has no strings to hold him back now.
movies.title: Pinocchio: Unstrung

movies.overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.
movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further

movies.overview: Explorers in Mexico uncover the ruins of an ancient snake-worshiping civilization. Celebration turns to horror when they awaken an ever-growing anaconda, starved of human sacrifices for centuries. Now, the team must band together to survive.
movies.title: The Anacondas

movies.overview: Five social media influencers spend a weekend at a forest retreat but inadvertently awaken and confront the world's first vampire.
movies.title: Feed

movies.overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.
movies.title: Clayface

movies.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.
movies.title: Obsession

movies.overview: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.
movies.tagline: 戦後、日本。無（ゼロ）から負（マイナス）へ。
movies.title: Godzilla Minus One

movies.overview: After a difficult divorce, Alicia moves into an old house with her daughter Carla, unaware that it hides a past of recurrent tragedy. As Carla senses perturbing presences, Alicia begins to doubt her own sanity. A blue dress connects Carla to the ghost of a girl from the past, triggering terrifying events. Mother and daughter will try to escape the house, but the house won’t let them get away so easily.
movies.tagline: You can't run away from it.
movies.title: Evil Dress

movies.overview: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.
movies.title: Crawlers

movies.overview: Two security guards working the midnight shift in an adult toy company find themselves the target of a half-dismantled and severely malfunctioning female sex doll prototype named Robotica.
movies.tagline: Built for pleasure. Out For Blood.
movies.title: Robotica

movies.overview: Searching for her missing brother, a young woman traces his final signal to an abandoned warehouse, where she discovers a collection of cursed VHS tapes. Captured and forced to watch, she endures four found-footage nightmares that may reveal what happened to him—and what now awaits her.
movies.tagline: Once You Press Play, You Can't Go Back
movies.title: Insidious Rewind

movies.original_title: ネバーアフターダーク
movies.overview: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.
movies.title: Never After Dark

movies.overview: Following the path of Cecilia, from Red Days, a young woman becomes a vampire during a zombie outbreak. In order to survive and find a new home, she joins a secret organization that turns her into a corporate slayer.
movies.title: Red Days 2: Cecilia

movies.overview: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.
movies.title: Backrooms

movies.overview: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.
movies.tagline: They unleashed their deadliest weapon on us.
movies.title: Onslaught

movies.overview: Wandering her rambling old house in her boring new town, 11-year-old Coraline discovers a hidden door to a strangely idealized version of her life. In order to stay in the fantasy, she must make a frighteningly real sacrifice.
movies.tagline: Be careful what you wish for.
movies.title: Coraline

movies.overview: In a notorious prison, an invisible force begins killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.
movies.title: Ghost in the Cell

movies.overview: The members of a supernatural exploration club called 0.0MHz explores a haunted house to prove the existence of frequencies that attract ghosts.
movies.tagline: It only ends with a death.
movies.title: 0.0MHz

movies.overview: Teens trespass deserted Mickey's Playhouse amusement park, confronting dark history and personal fears as thrill-seeking turns harrowing amid lingering spirits.
movies.title: Mickey's Slayhouse

movies.overview: A man keeping his recently zombified daughter secure in hopes of a cure is tasked with delivering an unknown package through hordes of undead. If he succeeds, he will be given a cure for his daughter. If he fails, or opens the package, they will both be killed.
movies.title: Resident Dead

movies.overview: A marine biologist is doing research on a fish farm when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see?
movies.tagline: Only 5% of the ocean has been explored for a reason…
movies.title: Kraken

movies.overview: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.
movies.title: Colony

movies.overview: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.
movies.tagline: You can't bury the past forever.
movies.title: The Cycle

movies.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.
movies.title: Ice Cream Man

movies.overview: A group of nominated influencers participate in a streaming contest hosted by an energy drink brand, only to get hacked, locked in their rooms, and hunted physically and psychologically by anonymous online haters.
movies.title: HATERNET

movies.overview: In 1979, a group of young filmmakers set out to make an adult film in rural Texas, but when their reclusive, elderly hosts catch them in the act, the cast find themselves fighting for their lives.
movies.tagline: Dying to show you a good time.
movies.title: X

movies.overview: Three backpackers head to a Slovakian city that promises to meet their hedonistic expectations, with no idea of the hell that awaits them.
movies.title: Hostel

movies.overview: After the Creed family's cat is accidentally killed, a friendly neighbor advises its burial in a mysterious nearby cemetery.
movies.title: Pet Sematary

movies.overview: After moving to a quiet suburban neighborhood, the Seversons meet the Kringles, a family that celebrates Christmas year-round. When Mark, the father, discovers the Kringles' sinister yuletide intentions, he teams up with a badass Santa in a high-stakes, action-packed fight to save his family.
movies.title: Christmas at the Kringles

movies.overview: In late 15th-century Eastern Europe, Prince Vlad II’s bride is brutally murdered. As a result, he renounces God and damns Heaven itself. Cursed with eternal life, Vlad is reborn as Dracula, an immortal warlord who defies fate in a blood-soaked crusade to wrench his lost love back from death.
movies.tagline: He renounced his faith to become immortal. Passion, anger, vengeance, and hatred will be unleashed into the modern world.
movies.title: Dracula

movies.overview: The return of Leo San Juan and all the legends.
movies.title: La venganza del Charro Negro

movies.overview: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.
movies.title: Sinners

movies.overview: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.
movies.title: Evil Dead Burn

movies.overview: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.
movies.title: Halloween

movies.overview: Five years after surviving Art the Clown's Halloween massacre, Sienna and Jonathan are still struggling to rebuild their shattered lives. As the holiday season approaches, they try to embrace the Christmas spirit and leave the horrors of the past behind. But just when they think they're safe, Art returns, determined to turn their holiday cheer into a new nightmare. The festive season quickly unravels as Art unleashes his twisted brand of terror, proving that no holiday is safe.
movies.title: Terrifier 3

movies.overview: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren work to help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse. Forced to confront a powerful entity, the Warrens find themselves caught in the most terrifying case of their lives.
movies.tagline: Based on the true case files of the Warrens.
movies.title: The Conjuring

movies.original_title: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City
movies.overview: Once the booming home of pharmaceutical giant Umbrella Corporation, Raccoon City is now a dying Midwestern town. The company’s exodus left the city a wasteland…with great evil brewing below the surface. When that evil is unleashed, the townspeople are forever…changed…and a small group of survivors must work together to uncover the truth behind Umbrella and make it through the night.
movies.title: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City

movies.overview: For ten years, the tortured soul of serial killer Charles Lee Ray has been imprisoned inside a child's doll. 'Chucky' is reborn when his old flame, Tiffany, rescues his battered doll parts from a police impound. But Chucky wants his new playmate cut down to size, so he transforms his blushing bride into a stunning little terror. Chucky and Tiffany can't wait to start their own homicidal honeymoon. When this demonic duo hits the road and hooks up with a pair of unsuspecting newlyweds, they leave a trail of murder and mayhem behind them. Chucky's back!
movies.title: Bride of Chucky

movies.original_title: Apocalipsis Z: el principio del fin
movies.overview: When a kind of rabies that transforms people into aggressive creatures spreads across the planet, Manel isolates himself at home with his cat, relying on his wits to survive; but soon they must go out in search of food, by land and by sea, dodging many dangers.
movies.tagline: The beginning of the end has arrived.
movies.title: Apocalypse Z: The Beginning of the End

movies.overview: Camp counselors are stalked and murdered by an unknown assailant while trying to reopen a summer camp that was the site of a child's drowning.
movies.tagline: They were warned...They are doomed...And on Friday the 13th, nothing will save them.
movies.title: Friday the 13th

movies.overview: Daniel Lonces is a successful horror writer who decides to put himself in his protagonist’s shoes and experience firsthand what it means to be tied and gagged. But a tragic accident leaves his wife dead, him trapped, and his 11-month-old baby defenseless. Desperate, David struggles to free himself while facing unexpected dangers inside and outside his home.
movies.title: Tied Up

movies.overview: When a massive, gilled monster emerges from the deep and tears through the city, the government scrambles to save its citizens. A rag-tag team of volunteers cuts through a web of red tape to uncover the monster's weakness and its mysterious ties to a foreign superpower. But time is not on their side - the greatest catastrophe to ever befall the world is about to evolve right before their very eyes.
movies.tagline: A god incarnate. A city doomed.
movies.title: Shin Godzilla
